evidence.source_title: Leadership Pipeline Institute A/S - Annual Report for 2023
evidence.evidence_note: The audited 2023 annual report for Leadership Pipeline Institute A/S, CVR 29971463, presents Note 6 under the parent company financial statements as Investments in subsidiaries and lists Leadership Pipeline Institute Canada Inc., Canada, share capital CAD 100, ownership 100%.

decision.basis: The audited Danish annual report filed through Virk identifies Leadership Pipeline Institute A/S, CVR 29971463, as the parent-company investor in Leadership Pipeline Institute Canada Inc. with 100% ownership.
